patch_description: Increase radius_scale from 1.0 to 1.5 while retaining full allocation. In five dimensions, uniform-volume sampling concentrates toward the relocation boundary, so this increases the distance explored around the refreshed best. Persistent interval-end errors motivate testing broader coverage, although they do not establish insufficient radius as the cause. This moderate expansion tests an intermediate setting between the corrected baseline and the radius-two policies studied previously. Performance remains to be measured.
